Survivor V2: same skip in build_mips passes all tests and lets a non-finite value reach output. ARQ-110. Code correct today.
Survivor V3: entropy in unpremultiply passes all tests. No test repeats unpremultiply or the Rgba8 conversions. Code correct today.
The property test ARQ-110 names (finite input gives finite output) is missing: no proptest! block in the crate. Probe p18 holds.
Odd side undecided. Dropping fits the text but is not stated; 1000x600 top pixel sees 512 of 1000 columns (0 against 185.5). Owner decides.
One error enum per crate against BufferError plus EffectError in raster. Settle before the first Effect or Transition.

ARQ-110 pixel property draws 0 or 1 pixel and hardly reaches the Err arm. New test gap.
Identity difference 0 is tested at 1e-6. M1 (Cs held in f32) survives all 55 tests. Code holds today (p20).
Alpha cap tested on the backdrop only. M2a (f32) and M2b (8-bit) on the source survive. Code holds today (p6, p21).
ARQ-110: M3 (result check skips alpha) survives and would return Ok with infinite alpha. Code holds today (p19).
Claimed equivalent (b) is false: with no Cs == 0 guard a -0.0 source gives +inf in ColorBurn. Survives the tests. Code holds today (p9).
Blending space unstated: blend_u8 on encoded sRGB in Preview, blend_f32 linear in Export; grey gaps up to 232/255. Rule before gafira-render-cpu.
Source a = 0 must leave the backdrop, but clipping changes an out-of-range backdrop in non-Normal modes (1.5 to 1.0). Spec must say which wins.
W3C says the mixing result must be clamped; it is not. Non-separable modes give channels down to -4.4e-16 on valid input. Unlisted deviation.
Property draws from 1e30, so every channel clips to 0 or 1; it never reaches the interior. Its [0, 1] assertion is false there (W3).
